title: Pearson Edexcel GCSE (9-1) English Language (1EN0) — Paper 1: Fiction and Imaginative Writing

authority.file: MSR/Edexcel GCSE English Language Paper 1/Edexcel GCSE English Language Paper 1 Mark Scheme/June 2024 MS - Paper 1 Edexcel English Language GCSE.pdf
authority.why_this_source: The board's own published mark scheme — top of the authority order (PEDAGOGY.md, Neil 2026-08-16). Our spec's provenance line for this paper read 'verified by Neil 2026-04-02', a human check rather than a citation, which is exactly the shape of claim that was wrong on Edexcel IGCSE P1 for four months. Now cited.
authority.path_note: ⚠️ A prior handoff reported that MSR held a Paper 1 .md but NO Paper 1 PDF, and proposed a new GEC/ alias pointing at 'My Drive/GCSE English Courses' so the older 1EN0_01_msc_20190117.pdf could be cited. That is NOT needed: a June 2024 Paper 1 PDF does exist inside MSR, in 'Edexcel GCSE English Language Paper 1/…Mark Scheme/' rather than in the 'Makr Schemes' folder that was checked. Both papers resolve under the existing MSR alias, so no engine change is required.

total.why: The mark scheme states each question's tariff, not a paper total. 1+2+6+15 = 24 (Section A) + 40 (Section B) = 64, which matches language-paper-specs.json.

questions.quote_note: Anchored to the mark-column value on the question's own line. The earlier anchor stated no tariff at all and passed the gate only because the phrase happened to contain the digit 1 — evidence by coincidence is not evidence.
Anchored to the LAST occurrence: Section B offers a choice of two tasks and the document prints '(40 marks)' once per option.

components.label: content and organisation
components.why: 40 total minus the 16 the board states for vocabulary and sentence structures.

components.label: technical accuracy
components.quote: (includes 16 marks for the range of vocabulary and sentence structures

questions.note: Section B is a CHOICE of two tasks — the board's grids are headed 'Writing assessment grids for Question 5 and Question 6'. Our spec models the choice as a single Q5, which is the same 40 marks either way.
